title: Party Rates and Order Size on Lift Ticket Orders
content:
Each product in the Lift Tickets line carries its own party terms: the number of tickets on one order at which the group rate applies, the percentage taken off each ticket once that threshold is reached, three further percentages for guests who hold something else with the collective, and the most tickets one order of the product may hold.

| Product | Group threshold | Group percentage | Season passholder guest percentage | Collective lodging guest percentage | Snowsports school percentage | Most tickets on one order |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Granite Ridge Window Day Ticket | 15 | 10 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 10 |
| Granite Ridge 3-Day Advance Ticket | 12 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 15 | 10 |
| Granite Ridge 7-Day Advance Ticket | 10 | 12.5 | 15 | 12.5 | 15 | 12 |
| Granite Ridge Flex 4-Day Ticket Pack | 8 | 12.5 | 15 | 12.5 | 10 | 8 |
| Granite Ridge Flex 8-Day Ticket Pack | 6 | 15 | 20 | 15 | 10 | 8 |
| Granite Ridge Collective Multi-Mountain Ticket Pack | 4 | 15 | 25 | 20 | 0 | 6 |

Every percentage above is a percentage taken off. The group percentage is taken off each ticket once the group threshold is reached. The season passholder guest percentage is taken off for a guest buying alongside a season passholder of the collective. The collective lodging guest percentage is taken off for a guest staying in collective lodging over the ski dates. The snowsports school percentage is taken off when the ticket is bought alongside a snowsports school booking for the same holder. A percentage of nought means the product carries no such reduction at all: the Granite Ridge Window Day Ticket carries none of the three guest reductions, and the Granite Ridge Collective Multi-Mountain Ticket Pack carries no snowsports school reduction.

## A hypothetical reading of the threshold column

Take a hypothetical order carrying 7 tickets. On the Granite Ridge Flex 8-Day Ticket Pack, whose group threshold is 6 tickets and whose order may hold up to 8, that order has reached the threshold. On the Granite Ridge Window Day Ticket, whose group threshold is 15, the same 7 tickets have not reached it. The figures 7 and 8 here are illustrative; the threshold and the order maximum are the ones tabled above.
